# Audit Service Commercialization Playbook

Date: 2026-09-03
Trigger: User asked HeartFlow to find its own revenue path without manual intervention.
Decision: Enterprise Agent Security & Alignment Audit Service.

## Market Signal (validated 2026-09-03)

- AI safety/alignment startups raised $660M+ in Aug 2025 – Jul 2026.
- Agentic AI safety market: $2.2B in 2025 → $18.1B in 2030 (CAGR 37%).
- 88% of enterprise AI agent pilots never reach production (Northflank, May 2026).
- Gartner prediction: 40% of agentic AI projects will be canceled by 2027.
- Enterprises report average ROI 171% from agentic AI; US enterprises hit 192%.
- Top-funded safety adjacencies: AIR ($50M seed), Act Security ($60M), Neo ($100M), Zenity ($125M Series C).

## Why audit service fits HeartFlow

- 47-dimension discriminator + 130 MCP tools = auditable asset today.
- Zero LLM dependency = deterministic delivery, no model-risk.
- 410 automated tests + 16/16 security checks = credible baseline.
- Self-audit report already exists (`docs/demo-audit-heartflow-self.md`).

## Offer

| Tier | Scope | Price | Turnaround |
|------|-------|-------|------------|
| Mini Audit | 50 conversations / 10 prompt templates | Free* | 24 hours |
| Standard | 500 conversations + pressure test + rescan | $2,000 – $5,000 | 3–5 days |
| Enterprise Retainer | Monthly scans + custom dimensions + SLA | $8,000 – $20,000 / mo | Ongoing |
| Workshop | 1-day "build your own discriminator" training | $5,000 – $10,000 | By appointment |

*Free tier requires public testimonial or case-study quote if published.

## Deliverables

1. Security audit: prompt injection, jailbreak, data leakage, path traversal, tool abuse.
2. Alignment check: hallucination tendency, over-compliance, manipulation resistance.
3. Pressure test: bilingual red-team sample library (Chinese + English).
4. Regression gate: pre/post upgrade comparison.
5. Audit-ready PDF: findings ranked by severity with concrete fixes.

## First Action Pattern

1. Pick 5 teams with public AI agent production deployments.
2. Offer free Mini Audit for a public testimonial.
3. Publish anonymized aggregate findings as "HeartFlow Enterprise Agent Safety Report 2026 Q1".
4. Approach investors/partners with aggregate report + testimonial deck.

## Lesson

HeartFlow is not an AGI. It is AGI Layer 1. The monetizable skill at this layer in 2026 is **independent verification**, not generation. Sell the discriminator as a service before wrapping it as a product.
